title: Detailed spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>

  <!-- top body: cone shape -->
  <polygon points='50,18 72,62 28,62' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <!-- cone highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,18 62,50 50,55 42,50' fill='#ff7b5c' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- cone left shadow -->
  <polygon points='50,18 28,62 40,62' fill='#c0291f'/>

  <!-- upper band / collar -->
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='24' height='7' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='38' y='40' width='24' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>

  <!-- mid wide stripe -->
  <rect x='30' y='56' width='40' height='8' rx='2' fill='#3ec6e0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='56' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#8ef0ff'/>

  <!-- spin lines -->
  <line x1='43' y1='22' x2='41' y2='32' stroke='#ff9d8a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='22' x2='59' y2='32' stroke='#ff9d8a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='24' x2='50' y2='34' stroke='#ffb3a3' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bottom skirt -->
  <polygon points='28,62 72,62 64,74 36,74' fill='#2d7d46'/>
  <polygon points='28,62 50,62 50,74 36,74' fill='#1f5e34'/>
  <polygon points='50,62 72,62 64,74 50,74' fill='#3fa85c'/>

  <!-- rim disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='9' ry='2.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>

  <!-- axle / tip -->
  <rect x='47' y='78' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#c9c9d9'/>
  <rect x='47' y='78' width='2.5' height='8' rx='1' fill='#f0f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='87' r='3' fill='#9b9bb8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='87' r='1.3' fill='#d6d6ee'/>

  <!-- top knob -->
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='8' height='7' rx='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='4' fill='#3ec6e0'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='9.8' r='1.5' fill='#b8fbff'/>

  <!-- motion swooshes around the top -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q24 46 30 50' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0ff' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M16 60 Q23 55 29 59' fill='none' stroke='#b8fbff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 50 Q76 44 70 48' fill='none' stroke='#ff9d8a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 58 Q77 53 71 57' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3a3' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 30 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <path d='M80 26 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 z' fill='#b8fbff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='1.6' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='70' r='1.4' fill='#ff9d8a'/>
</svg>
